rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The party heads his address of 24 March 2001 'Opening Remarks : Shri K. Jana Krishnamurthy, President, BJP' and 'Address of Shri K. Jana Krishnamurthy National President, BJP To the National Executive of Bharatiya Janata Party on 24th March, 2001 at Parliament Annexe, New Delhi', and in it he says 'you find me addressing this august house today from the Chair of the President'.

locator.section: heading block; paragraph ending 'from the Chair of the President'

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: In the same address he tells the National Executive: 'The very fact that you have entrusted the responsibility of party presidentship to me is proof positive that I enjoy your trust, confidence as well as your total cooperation'.

locator.section: paragraph beginning 'The very fact that you have entrusted'

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: In the same address he says Shri Bangaru Laxman's 'resignation letter of 13.3.2001 addressed to me which reached my hands by midnight that day' said 'pending enquiry and in keeping with the high moral standards of the BJP I hereby offer to step down from the office of the president of the party'.

locator.section: paragraph beginning 'When Tehelka.com tapes found their way'

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The same address says 'the available Office-bearers who met on the 14th had no other option but to accept the resignation'.

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The same address says the office bearers 'asked me to shoulder the responsibility in his place. Being the senior most Vice-president of the Party I had to accept it for the party cannot afford to be headless'.
